newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money market rates on low fund demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money market rates on low fund demand.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates sliped at close on Wednesday amid a low demand for funds but could rise on Thursday on settlement of an auction of short-term federal bonds (STFBs), dealers said.

The overnight offers were at eight percent in early trade in anticipation of an open market operation, but dropped later to three percent and closed at the same level owing to lack of borrowing interest, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan picked up 1.7 billion rupees in the open market operation at a cutoff yield of 16.50 percent, he said.
The overnight rates may rise on Thursday as 9.371 billion rupees will go out of the market in the settlement of the STFB auction against an inflow of 5.5 billion rupees, dealers said.
